narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>Colour any three sectors, and the figure has three angles of symmetry.
<bookmark mark='side'/>Colour three sectors side by side, and turn the circle by one hundred twenty degrees.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>The colours do not match, so the sectors must be spread out evenly.
removed_beats.on_screen: Chintu's bubble says colour any three sectors; three coloured sectors side by side are turned by 120° and the colours do not match; the bubble is struck through in the warning colour

narration: <bookmark mark='check'/>To check, turn your coloured circle one sector at a time, and count where the colours match.
<bookmark mark='full'/>Go on up to the full turn, and that count is the number of angles.
removed_beats.on_screen: the stage clears except the anchor; the recap board shows the check: turn the coloured circle 30° at a time and count the turns where the colours match, up to 360°

old_misconception.wrong_move: Chintu says colour any three sectors and the figure has three angles of symmetry. Three sectors side by side match again only after the full turn, so the bubble is struck.
